rules.cite: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance; Ellis Implementation Ordinance
rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to Berkeley's rent stabilization and Ellis ordinances where owner move-in or Ellis Act evictions occur.
rules.quote:
The standard relocation assistance payment will increase to
$19,413
.
rules.requirement: Owners must pay tenants relocation assistance when evicting for owner move-in or to withdraw a property from the rental market. The standard payment is $19,413 from January 1, 2026, with an additional $6,471 for qualifying households.
tenancy_conditions: owner move-in or Ellis Act eviction
rules.title: 2026 relocation assistance for OMI and Ellis evictions
